description: Auto-rig a static 3D model (GLB) into an animation-ready model: adds a humanoid skeleton and skin weights so it can be posed and animated. Provide the GLB URL of a model (e.g. one generated by the other tools). Renders the rigged result inline in an interactive 3D viewer. Use this when you already have a static model; to generate and rig a character in one step call forge_avatar instead.

glb_url.description: http(s) URL to the static GLB mesh to rig.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key. Send the same key again (same caller, same arguments, within 24 hours) and you get the original job back instead of a second generation, so a retry after a timeout cannot burn quota twice. Use a fresh key for each distinct request. A failed attempt is not remembered, so its key can be reused.

name: rig_mesh
title: Rig a 3D model for animation
